singleSourced.context: While I never relish in 'um, actually'-ing anybody, I am unfortunately a videogame journalist and do have to look into these things: "just before the release of the original Burning Crusade" is a bit of a misnomer (and a change from the original announcement, which said "weeks").

Vanilla WoW added the XP-to-gold conversion in Patch 1.10.0, confirmed both here on a wiki and, god bless, the Octopus Overlords forum, which still miraculously has a news post from 20 years ago around the time of the patches' release that mentions the "Quest Experience to Gold Conversion at Level 60." I was also able to dig up these Shacknews and Macnews articles which both also mention it.
